description: Diagnostic daemon to investigate the repeated importlib error pattern affecting registry_api.py, rug_pull_monitor.py, signal_analyser.py (all show traceback at line 10, File "<frozen importlib"). Since these files are protected and cannot be rebuilt directly, this diagnostic: (1) attempts to import each file via subprocess with detailed error capture, (2) checks Python sys.path for corruption, (3) verifies __pycache__ consistency, (4) reports which specific import statement is failing. Does NOT modify any file. Does NOT write to database. Output is structured JSON for ops review. This is a diagnostic-only companion module per spec section 10 rule: prefer diagnosis over rebuild for protected files.
